The following events took place in '''398 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*By early this year, the [[Battle of Sintheti]] had concluded.<ref name="EGTWACp2" />
*In or around this year, the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Reverie]]'' was constructed.<ref name="Ship of Fear" />
*Six [[Planet/Legends|planets]] reportedly went bankrupt due to the expenses accumulated in building the ''Reverie''.<ref name="Ship of Fear" />
